command: set -euo pipefail; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')"; adb -s "$serial" install -r -d app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb -s "$serial" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 5; echo APP_INSTALLED_AND_LAUNCHED
